preconditions.expression: t == int(stdin.split()[0]) and t >= 1 and t <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is the number of test cases t, where 1 ≤ t ≤ 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 2000 for n in [int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()])
preconditions.description: Each test case starts with an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2000) representing the number of vertices in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(len(edges) == n - 1 for n, edges in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], [stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+n] for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], 1)]))
preconditions.description: Each test case has exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree with n vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= int(x) <= n and 1 <= int(y) <= n for x, y in [line.split() for line in edges]) for n, edges in zip([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], [stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+n] for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], 1)]))
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices x and y, where 1 ≤ x, y ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_lines) == t for t, output_lines in zip([int(stdin.split()[0])], [stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+n] for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], 1)]))
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly t lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i].isdigit() for i, output_lines in enumerate([stdin.splitlines()[i+1:i+n] for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], 1)], 1))
postconditions.description: Each output line must be a nonnegative integer.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == 0 if n == 1 else int(output_lines[i]) == 1 if n == 2 else int(output_lines[i]) == 2 for i, n in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::] if line.strip() and line.split()[0].isdigit()], 1))
postconditions.description: For n = 1, the answer is 0 (no queries needed). For n = 2, the answer is 1 (one query suffices). For n ≥ 3, the answer is 2 (two queries suffice to uniquely identify the hidden vertex x).
